description: Simboli — Colore: Platinum & silvery gold Collezione: The Foxes' Wedding, Imago Codice: 5771 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Tribal Scala: Extra Small Altezza: 140 cm Rapporto: 10 cm × 10 cm Toni: Light grey SIMBOLI is organized around an interlocking geometric system that draws on decorative tradition — a framework in which the complexity of the whole emerges from the disciplined repetition of simple forms. Its mark-making is meditative in the original sense: a surface that rewards sustained attention, where the eye follows interlocking lines across the field without arriving at a terminus. Clean and precise at distance, SIMBOLI reveals increasing complexity on approach. Its dual nature — modern in its graphic clarity, ancient in its geometric logic — makes it one of the most versatile textiles in the IMAGO collection : equally at home in minimal contemporary interiors and layered, eclectic schemes.
